title: Represent a problem as states
summary: A state is a description of the current situation. An action changes one state into another. A goal describes the state we want to reach.
introduction: A state is a description of the current situation. An action changes one state into another. A goal describes the state we want to reach. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain represent a problem as states
Use the example to answer a practice question
